snippet.title: NPC Simulator: Heroes Need Us – First Trailer & Demo Reveal!
snippet.description:
Try out the fresh demo, where you can try out a small portion of the content that is planned to be added:
Explore trading, gambling, and relationships in NPC Simulator: Heroes Need Us—a cozy, atmospheric pixel RPG.

Available for Windows, MacOS and Linux on itch.io:
https://fellow-pablo.itch.io/npc-simulator-heroes-need-us
Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3498880/NPC_Simulator_Heroes_Need_Us/

Feel free to contact me if you will find some issues!
